description.value:
Because House Thuranni is young and devoted to espionage, its leaders expect you to advance its interests at every chance. In these formative years as an independent house, your every move has been closely watched. Not every Thuranni heir must spy at the elders' command, but even the house's most reclusive artists and artisans must follow current politics and gather or pass on information when asked.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Intelligence, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.0HHEsUor1RwXy2wh]{Mark of Shadow}

Skill Proficiencies: Performance and Stealth

Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCostume0000]{Costume}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 13 GP; or (B) 50 GP

FCAxzMRrXWU8TPOn.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
FCAxzMRrXWU8TPOn.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
